statement: The pinned ALSA UCM DualSense profile configures four hardware playback and two hardware capture channels. Its HiFi split maps headphones to playback channels 0/1, internal mono speaker to playback channel 1, internal microphone to capture channel 0, and headset capture to channels 0/1; it treats speaker versus headphones and microphone versus headset as conflicting logical devices. It does not define the physical grip/haptic roles of playback channels 2/3.

applicability.scope: Consumer routing configuration only; direct hardware channels are not evidence of audible outputs.
